title: Set tipper to AUTO mode so it waits for WCS instructions
summary: Place the tipper in AUTO mode so it waits for the WCS to send instructions.
when_to_use: Use when starting/operating the tipper and you need the tipper to wait for WCS instructions by placing it into AUTO mode.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Set the tipper mode to AUTO on the operator station HMI/control panel and verify the tipper reflects AUTO mode and is waiting for WCS instructions.
access_or_tools_needed: Operator station HMI/control panel (tipper mode selection/status)

visual_references.description: Operator Station Control Panel (Visu_MCP_Dual screen) showing the AUTO button and CYCLE START/CYCLE STOP controls.
Operator station main screen showing the CYCLE STOP button (used on the operator station main screen).

steps.title: Locate the tipper mode control on the operator station HMI
steps.purpose: Identify the control used to switch the tipper into AUTO mode.
steps.instruction: On the operator station control panel (Visu_MCP_Dual / operator station main screen), locate the tipper mode control, including the AUTO button.
steps.expected_result: The AUTO control/button is visible and ready to be selected on the operator station HMI/control panel.
steps.healthy_condition: The operator station control panel is displaying the tipper controls including AUTO (and related cycle controls).
steps.failure_condition: The AUTO control/button is not visible or cannot be selected on the operator station HMI/control panel.

actions.label: Find AUTO button
actions.exact_action: Locate the tipper mode control (AUTO button) on the operator station HMI/control panel.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 4-19: The Tipper Machine Control Panel ("Visu_MCP_Dual" screen) has an AUTO button that runs the tipper in automatic mode.

steps.title: Place the tipper in AUTO mode
steps.purpose: Switch the tipper into automatic mode so it will wait for WCS instructions.
steps.instruction: Select AUTO on the operator station HMI/control panel to place the tipper in AUTO mode.
steps.expected_result: The tipper is in AUTO mode.
steps.healthy_condition: After selecting AUTO, the tipper reflects AUTO mode on the operator station HMI/control panel.
steps.failure_condition: The tipper does not reflect AUTO mode after selection.

actions.label: Select AUTO
actions.exact_action: Press the AUTO button to enter automatic mode.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the tipper does not reflect AUTO mode after selection, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Step 6: Place the tipper in AUTO mode. The tipper will wait for the WCS to send instructions.
Figure 4-19: The AUTO button runs the tipper in automatic mode.

steps.title: Confirm the tipper is waiting for WCS instructions
steps.purpose: Verify the tipper is in the correct state for WCS-driven operation.
steps.instruction: Verify on the operator station HMI/control panel that the tipper is in AUTO mode and is waiting for WCS instructions.
steps.expected_result: Tipper is in AUTO mode and waits for the WCS to send instructions.
steps.healthy_condition: The operator station indicates the tipper is in AUTO mode and in a waiting state for WCS instructions.
steps.failure_condition: The tipper is not in AUTO mode or is not waiting for WCS instructions.

actions.label: Check AUTO/waiting state
actions.exact_action: Confirm the tipper is in AUTO mode and is waiting for WCS instructions.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the tipper does not reflect AUTO mode after selection, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Step 6: Place the tipper in AUTO mode. The tipper will wait for the WCS to send instructions.
Context summary: Placing the tipper in AUTO mode allows it to wait for and receive instructions from the WCS.

success_criteria: Tipper reflects AUTO mode on the operator station HMI/control panel.
Tipper is in a state where it waits for WCS instructions.
healthy_conditions: Tipper is in AUTO mode and waits for the WCS to send instructions.
failure_conditions: Tipper does not reflect AUTO mode after selection.
Tipper is not waiting for WCS instructions.
escalation_guidance: Stop and escalate if the tipper does not reflect AUTO mode after selection.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: Place the tipper in AUTO mode. The tipper will wait for the WCS to send instructions.
Figure 4-19: The AUTO button runs the tipper in automatic mode.

missing_details: The packet does not provide the exact HMI indicator text/field name that explicitly shows the tipper is 'waiting for the WCS to send instructions' (only the manual statement that this is what AUTO mode does).
